description: Perun, the old Slavic god of thunder, a mighty dignified man in his prime with a long thick copper-red beard and long copper hair, stern wise grey eyes, a plain bronze circlet on his brow, a dark red cloak pinned with a bronze brooch over a shirt of bronze scale armour, holding a great bearded battle axe up at his shoulder, thin bright blue-white lightning crackling around the axe blade, no birds, head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, slavic pagan mythology, dignified, muted natural colours
